title: Drupal fixes an exploited flaw on sites with an exposed installer. CVE-2026-136716 is being exploited; Drupal advises updating, running update.php, securing the installer and reviewing access
content_md:
Drupal fixes an exploited flaw on sites with an exposed installer. CVE-2026-136716 is being exploited; Drupal advises updating, running update.php, securing the installer and reviewing access.

via Mastodon https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/falha-critica-drupal-explorada-instalador-exposto/

CVE-2026-136716.evidence: The report states that Drupal confirmed CVE-2026-136716 is being exploited against sites with an exposed installer.
